notes.nti: Ni introduces what is said or thought.
notes.nzikiriza: Ye is to accept or agree.

guidebook.intro: Follow the news, speak at a meeting and give your opinion with **ni**, “that”.

tips.title: Giwaco ni…
body: **Ni** introduces what someone says or thinks: **Waco ni kot tye ka bino** (he says that rain is coming), **Aparo ni ber** (I think that it’s good).

tips.title: Tami obedo ngo?
body: **Tam** is an opinion or idea: **Tami obedo ngo?** (what is your opinion?), **I tam mera** (in my opinion). Agree with **Ayee lokki** (I accept your word); disagree politely with **Timwa kica, pe ayee**.

culture.title: Radio in the north
body: Radio stations in Gulu broadcast in Acholi and were a lifeline during the war, with programmes that called fighters home. Today they carry news, debate and call-in shows.
